subject: gk
question: Western disturbances cause:

options.text: rainfall during winters in the south part of India
rainfall during summers in the north west part of India
rainfall during winters in the north west part of India
rainfall during summers in the north east part of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**rainfall during winters in the northwest part of India.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Western disturbance is an extratropical storm originating in the Mediterranean region
